name: Aerospace
title: Aircraft maintenance records readiness
summary: Assemble configuration-sensitive maintenance evidence for licensed personnel without granting release-to-service authority.
situation: Illustrative architecture: An aircraft maintenance organization prepares a scheduled check while late defect reports and component changes arrive from line operations. Planners need applicable task cards, part traceability, and outstanding records in one review packet. Agents assist evidence preparation; authorized maintenance personnel retain technical decisions and release authority.
problem: Maintenance applicability depends on aircraft configuration, component serial history, and controlled document revisions. A plausible task summary can omit a prerequisite or cite instructions for a different configuration. Missing traceability cannot be repaired by generated narrative.
whyAgents: Configuration, technical-publication, material, and records specialists retrieve independent evidence. A deterministic applicability service constrains candidate tasks, while the workflow preserves unresolved records and explicitly requires qualified review.
outcome: The intended result is a reviewable operational decision with source evidence and explicit ownership. Assess records preparation and review corrections rather than asserting improved airworthiness. The architecture's contribution is traceable readiness evidence; technical judgment and authorized maintenance execution remain distinct responsibilities.

agents.name: Configuration reconciler
agents.responsibility: Compare aircraft configuration and serialized component history with the planned check.
agents.boundary: Cannot amend certified records or establish final task applicability.

agents.name: Publication retrieval agent
agents.responsibility: Retrieve controlled task cards and referenced procedures for the reviewed configuration.
agents.boundary: Cannot rewrite approved instructions or substitute unofficial guidance.

agents.name: Material traceability agent
agents.responsibility: Check part identity, availability, and required supporting records.
agents.boundary: Cannot approve a part for installation or waive missing traceability.

agents.name: Records readiness agent
agents.responsibility: Compile missing evidence, task dependencies, and reviewer questions.
agents.boundary: Cannot sign task completion or release an aircraft to service.

systems.name: Maintenance planning system
systems.role: Owns aircraft work packages, task status, and accountable maintenance assignments.

systems.name: Controlled technical library
systems.role: Provides applicable publication revisions and document access permissions.

systems.name: Component and records platform
systems.role: Retains serial histories, supporting records, and qualified signoffs independently of generated summaries.

flow.title: Open check package
flow.description: Bind the case to aircraft identity, planned maintenance scope, configuration snapshot, and responsible licensed reviewer.

flow.title: Resolve applicability
flow.description: Evaluate configured task rules and expose any missing component history before retrieving supporting technical material.

flow.title: Gather controlled instructions
flow.description: Fetch exact task-card revisions and prerequisites, linking originals instead of synthesizing replacement maintenance instructions.

flow.title: Verify material evidence
flow.description: Match required parts and supporting records to the work package; distinguish reserved stock from approved installation readiness.

flow.title: Present readiness gaps
flow.description: Show missing records, conflicting applicability, and task dependencies for qualified personnel to resolve before execution.

flow.title: Record reviewed package
flow.description: Save the accepted evidence manifest and outstanding obligations; actual work completion and release remain in existing signed maintenance processes.

failures.scenario: A component replacement is absent from the planning snapshot.
failures.detection: Serial history updates conflict with the configuration used for applicability.
failures.recovery: Invalidate dependent task selections and require a qualified applicability review against the corrected configuration.

failures.scenario: A technical publication is revised during package preparation.
failures.detection: Library revision notification differs from the manifest version.
failures.recovery: Flag affected tasks and route revision impact assessment to the authorized maintenance owner.

controls: Prevent agents from signing maintenance completion or release-to-service records.
Link controlled instructions verbatim through document references rather than generated procedural substitutes.
Bind every applicability result to aircraft and component configuration versions.
Treat missing component traceability as an unresolved blocker, never inferred provenance.
Separate planning readiness from technical airworthiness and final release decisions.

metrics.name: Readiness preparation time
metrics.definition: Time from package opening to a reviewer-ready list of evidence and unresolved dependencies.

metrics.name: Applicability correction rate
metrics.definition: Candidate tasks changed by qualified review divided by candidate tasks reviewed.

metrics.name: Traceability completeness
metrics.definition: Required component records available and verified divided by required records in the package.

metrics.name: Revision impact latency
metrics.definition: Time from controlled-document change to identification of affected open packages.

tradeoffs.cost: Depends on complete and current serialized history.
Reviewers still need access to source systems and full task context.

tradeoffs.benefit: Prevents silent acceptance of missing records.
tradeoffs.cost: Package preparation may remain open until external evidence arrives.

rollout.acceptance: Qualified staff verify applicability, revision handling, and missing-record treatment against completed checks.
One maintenance team evaluates packets with no changes to signed records or technical instructions.
Work-package drafts launch after configuration correction and publication-revision drills pass with named reviewers.
